description: This file defines a PHP interface named MenuConfigurator within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Menu. The interface declares a single method 'configure' that takes a Screen object and returns a MenuItem or null. It serves as a contract for classes that will implement menu configuration logic in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MenuConfigurator
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for menu configuration in the OrangeHRM system, requiring the implementation of the 'configure' method.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines a method that takes a Screen object and returns a MenuItem or null, serving as a contract for menu configuration implementations.
